title: Maximum resistance condition
description: Essential: The student must state or derive the condition for impending rightward slip, where the tension equals the sum of friction and magnetic force, leading to the maximum allowed resistance.

title: Minimum resistance condition
description: Essential: The student must state or derive the condition for impending leftward slip, where the magnetic force equals the sum of tension and friction, leading to the minimum allowed resistance.

title: Correct force balance
description: Important: The student's free-body diagram or equations must correctly include all horizontal forces: tension from the weight, kinetic friction, and magnetic force (BIl).

title: Application of Ohm's law
description: Important: The student must correctly relate the current in each limiting case to the circuit parameters using I = E/(R + r).

title: Correct friction direction
description: Important: The student must correctly assign the direction of the friction force opposite to the direction of impending motion in each limiting case.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The student's working should demonstrate consistent use of SI units (N, m, T, Ω, etc.) throughout the calculation.

title: Sign error in force equation
description: Pitfall: The student incorrectly adds or subtracts the magnetic force, friction, or tension, reversing the inequality for the resistance range.

title: Omits internal resistance
description: Pitfall: The student uses I = E/R, neglecting the internal resistance 'r' in the circuit equation.
